# testdata — TEST ONLY

Fixtures for the proxy's tests, and for the brain's, which read the goldens shared with the proxy
from here. Nothing in the proxy reads this directory at runtime. Accounts are on `example.com`;
no file holds a credential.

## `dialcheck_golden.json` (quota-model C2)

The dial check's golden fixtures (quota-model 50 §1.6, §5.1): standings in the shape of
`/preferred` `accounts{}`, a route's `pay`, `stop_at` and scope, the pots' budgets, the `ledger`
the budget gate reads (C6; null = none read), and the check each must give. Both evaluators run
it: the proxy's `dialcheck_test.go` and the brain's `test_exporter.py` (`DialCheckGoldenTest`).
The file is generated; change the generator's cases and both evaluators together, never one side.
Regenerate with `python3 testdata/gen_dialcheck_golden.py > testdata/dialcheck_golden.json`.

## `records_golden.json` (quota-model 64 §5)

What a held window does. A refusal is given as `POST /reports` carries it (`window`, `read_at`,
`until`, `resets_at`, `by_reading`, `seen`). `cases` judge it, step by step, against the
account's standing in the shape of `/preferred` `accounts{}`: whether it ends and, while it
holds, until when (null: until a reading ends it). `windows` map a hold and the window it covers
to the window it publishes: at 100, with its reset and that reset's basis. The proxy's
`record_golden_test.go` runs `cases` through `pruneRecords` and `windows` through
`recordWindow`; the brain's `test_exporter.py` (`RecordsGoldenTest`) runs them through
`_hold_judge` and `_hold_window`. `refusals` are refusal events as `POST /reports` carries them
(quota-model 67 §9): the brain's `TestRefusalsGolden` posts the `applied` ones in order and each
is applied, and each `refused` one alone. An applied case with a `record` is what this proxy's
encoder sends for that record, exactly (`reports_test.go`, `TestReportsRefusalsGolden`); one
without is an earlier proxy's shape. Generated; change the generator's cases and both sides
together, never one side.
Regenerate with `python3 testdata/gen_records_golden.py > testdata/records_golden.json`.

## `served_golden.json` (quota-model 65 §7)

The `served` event as the proxy sends it on `POST /reports` and the brain takes it; the file's
`_doc` says the rest. The proxy's `served_test.go` (`TestServedEncoderMatchesTheGolden`) checks
its encoder emits exactly each applied case's event; the brain's `test_exporter.py` answers and
prices every case. Hand-written.

## `preferred_c2.json` (quota-model C2)

The brain's real `/preferred` for one scenario, the clock held at a fixed instant. The scenario
holds an included, a paid, a stale, a stop_at, a codex-gate-closed and a `pay []` answer, and
(C6) a budget on codex credits with a counted and an uncounted ledger entry.
`preferred_cross_test.go` decodes it as the proxy does and checks that the proxy, with no record
of its own, reaches the brain's check on every (route, account) the brain lists. The file is
generated by running the brain on that scenario. Its generator, and the test that fails while
the file differs from what the brain serves, run the brain's fuller private edition, so they
are not published here.

## `session_facts_golden.json` (quota-model 68 §9, 69 §9)

`GET /_switch/session` replies for quota-model 68 §9's cases and 69 §9's `reset_now` cases, from
`preferred_c2.json` as edited case by case (`session_asks_test.go`).

## `codex_incomplete_132.sse` (#132)

The codex backend's real reply to a 126-tool request, captured from
gpt-6.1-sol. It was an HTTP 200 `text/event-stream` with four events: `response.created`,
`response.in_progress`, `response.metadata`, then `response.incomplete`. The last one has
`incomplete_details.reason: "max_output_tokens"`, zero usage and an empty `output`. The backend
turned the request away before generating anything.

Two edits were made. The echoed prompt (`response.instructions`, `tools` and `input`) is
dropped. `safety_identifier`, `prompt_cache_key` and `user` are redacted. The event order and
every other field are as received, but the response id, replaced by a made-up one.

`repro132_test.go` is its only consumer. Its tests check the fix: this reply reaches the client
as an error, not as an empty `end_turn`, and writes no health evidence. The file must end in a
blank line. Without it the parser drops the last event, and the tests would pass for the wrong
reason. A guard in `incomplete132()` checks for all four events.
